author: Yu Xin
external_inputs: NASA C-MAPSS FD001 data, obtained from the NASA public data portal
Python and LaTeX dependencies described in README.md and requirements-calibration.txt
reproducibility_notes: The public bundle contains compact calibration outputs; the large C1 prediction stores remain in the full research workspace.
C-MAPSS shared-model artifacts record training and evaluation seeds and configurations.
Calibration is descriptive and does not modify preregistered decision rules.
